---
title: Gantt in tabs
---

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="First">
    Nothing here.
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Timeline">
    ```mermaid
    gantt
        title Zero-downtime promote
        dateFormat ss
        axisFormat %S s
        section Old deployment
        Serving :a1, 00, 20s
        Draining :a2, after a1, 10s
        section New deployment
        Health checks :b1, 10, 10s
        Serving :b2, after b1, 20s
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Note>
  The old deployment keeps serving until the new one passes its health checks.
</Note>
